summary: Created a 5-phase implementation plan for the silent staging drop in git-commit-scoped.sh, grounded in the research report's code-level ruling. The plan builds a deterministic red fixture first, then adds a pre-commit intent snapshot plus a V8 post-commit integrity gate with a new dedicated exit code 5, pins the false-positive dimensions (staged deletions, directory pathspecs with ignored/ephemeral files, benign no-ops), records the ruling and the undocumented git commit -- pathspec working-tree-reread semantics, and closes with a source-store redeploy and the full gate set. Two research recommendations (a fail-closed .commit-lock mutex, caller escalation on the new exit code) are held out of scope as flagged follow-ups with stated rationale.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase, 6-hour plan: red fixture, V8 intent-snapshot/post-commit integrity gate with exit code 5, false-positive dimension tests, documentation of the ruling and git semantics, deploy plus full gate set.
